 Scorpio Shani Horoscope Today, 17 November 2026: Vrischika Sankranti, Shani Puts an Office Deadline Under Review

 Neeraj Dhankher / TOI Astrology / Nov 17, 2026, 04:45 IST Save Comments Share Aa + Text Size Small
 Medium
 Large
 Print Scorpio may need to reconsider by work deadline this Tuesday. The Sun has just moved into Scorpio, marking Vrischika Sankranti, and many families continue the Sankranti donations and prayers today. The Sun rules your tenth house of career, so its arrival in your own sign puts your professional performance firmly in the spotlight. Shani, retrograde in Pisces, your fifth house of planning and judgement, asks whether a current deadline is realistic. If it is not, today is the moment to say so, before stress turns into missed targets. The Sun Brings Your Work Into View 
 With the career lord in your first house, seniors notice your effort more than usual. That can be motivating. It can also tempt you to agree to timelines that look impressive but cannot be met. Vrischika Sankranti is a day for fresh resolve, and the most useful resolve may be honesty about what is possible. Watch Aries ,Taurus & Gemini : What This Phase May Be Trying to Warn You About | Ft. Shruti Kharbanda Look closely at the work still ahead and estimate the time it really needs. Shani’s Reality Check 
 Shani in your fifth house governs planning, intelligence and the quality of your output. Its retrograde often brings back tasks that were rushed or underestimated. If you sense that a project will slip, flag it now with a revised schedule and a clear reason. Most managers prefer early warning to last-minute surprises. Shani rewards that kind of responsible communication. Mars Pushes You to Overwork 
 Mars, your ruling planet, sits strong in Leo, your tenth house, with Jupiter and Ketu, and today is its own weekday. You may feel tempted to work late every night to meet the original target. Short bursts of extra effort are fine, but weeks of overwork will take a toll on your health. Jupiter beside Mars favours wiser planning over sheer force. Home and Office May Clash Tonight 
 By evening, the Moon moves into Aquarius, your fourth house of home, opposes Mars in your career house and passes near Rahu. Family may need your time just as work demands peak. Decide clearly when you will stop working tonight. Mercury, ruler of your eleventh house of gains, now moves direct, and Venus is direct as well. Support from colleagues improves over the coming days. Join conversation

 What to Do Today 
 Review the time needed for your current project honestly. If the deadline isn't realistic, suggest a new one with good reasons. Break the remaining work into smaller steps. Avoid committing to weeks of late nights. Set a firm time to stop work this evening and spend it with family. Shani Remedy for Today 
 As part of the Sankranti observance, give wheat flour and ghee to a family in need. Donate a solar lamp to a household that lacks reliable electricity.
